method: Pinned blob static declarations; line numbers are source lines. Multi-family assignments require all linked gates. No target parity is claimed.

families.title: POS identity and outlet access
families.preserve: Preserve three guards, assigned-outlet operator context, immutable OUTLET3 identity, permission defaults, password recovery and session revocation.
families.decision: Migrate identities with explicit collision maps; adapt guards/controllers; reuse permission checks. Do not equate POS outlet User with Website customer.
families.target_gate: Cross-role and cross-outlet direct requests denied; credential/reset/session behavior and historical shop ownership retained.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: POS products and master data
families.preserve: Preserve protected categories, variant key, brand/model/capacity/condition options, acquisition source, managed unit status and historical option usage.
families.decision: Reuse registries and validators; migrate IDs/options/usage; adapt persistence to shared schema. No category redesign.
families.target_gate: Category-aware validation, identifier uniqueness, disabled-option history and managed-option deletion safeguards match source assertions.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: POS acquisition and stock
families.preserve: Preserve acquisition, physical units and all required IMEI slots, quantity stock, pricing and stock-movement history.
families.decision: Reuse stock rules; refactor controller transactions into shared services; migrate units/movements. Preserve app-owned availability states.
families.target_gate: MySQL concurrent sale/reserve/return proves no oversell, duplicate IMEI or movement; rollback and inventory totals reconcile.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: POS sales invoices and returns
families.preserve: Preserve POS checkout, sale/invoice numbers, totals/discounts, customer snapshots, return/cancellation effects and outlet business identity.
families.decision: Reuse arithmetic and snapshots; refactor transactional controller work; migrate history; adapt React forms and print bindings.
families.target_gate: Legacy sale and negative flows, precise totals, returns, stock/accounting changes, historical invoices and permissions match.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: POS warranty and claims
families.preserve: Preserve warranty jobs, durations, versioned clauses, claims and sale-time warranty snapshots.
families.decision: Reuse clause validation/snapshot services; migrate claim/history relations; adapt interface.
families.target_gate: Expiry boundaries, claim lifecycle and role denial, old/new clause snapshots and document output retained.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: POS reports customer history and documents
families.preserve: Preserve outlet/customer history, dashboards, category reports, profit summaries, exports, invoice/warranty A4 and Thermal output and safe messaging.
families.decision: Reuse query/formatting/template contracts; adapt shared services and React screens. Preserve historical snapshot output.
families.target_gate: Role-scoped totals/CSV, filters and date boundaries; A4/80mm print/download; protected placeholders and safe communication links.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: POS Dynamic Platform presentation
families.preserve: Preserve distinct POS settings, branding/theme, safe media, navigation/form/table/dashboard/report presentation, preview/publish/revisions/rollback.
families.decision: Reuse settings registries and sanitizers; adapt runtime presentation from Blade to Inertia; migrate revisions/media usage.
families.target_gate: Per-section and publish permission checks, draft isolation, safe upload/path rules, cache invalidation, audit and rollback parity.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: POS backup audit and operations
families.preserve: Preserve backup manifests/history, download/delete rights, verify-only restore, code/key/target guards, secret-safe audit and operational health.
families.decision: Reuse manifest/redaction guards; adapt storage/process paths and shared-schema backup. Keep destructive reset separately guarded, never auto-run.
families.target_gate: Isolated backup/restore and failure tests; no secrets in audit/errors; ownership guards; recovery controls and scheduled job disablement.
families.target_owner: backend shared services and protected React/Inertia POS administration

families.title: Reservation confirmation release and reconciliation
families.preserve: Preserve reservation expiry, allocations, idempotency, replay checks, confirmation-versus-release exclusion, retries and reconciliation.
families.decision: Reuse state machine/contract validations; refactor transport into shared Laravel transactions. Retire dual-database transport only after replacement acceptance, never its invariants.
families.target_gate: Same request replay, conflicting request hashes, expiry/confirm/release races, partial failure/retry and order-stock-payment reconciliation on MySQL.
families.target_owner: backend shared transactional services and REST contracts

families.title: Website customer and admin identity
families.preserve: Preserve customer auth/account, owner/manager/content_editor/operations roles, permission matrix, admin avatar/profile/password, audit and signed order access.
families.decision: Reuse policy/validation and session boundaries; migrate identity mapping; adapt CMS administration into backend and public account into Next.js.
families.target_gate: Guest/customer/admin cross-role denial, account ownership, signed-link expiry, profile upload limits, last-owner safety and password reset parity.
families.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client

families.title: Public catalogue and comparison
families.preserve: Preserve category catalogue, search/filter/sort/pagination, product/variant details, comparison, availability, zero-stock visibility and legacy redirects.
families.decision: Reuse query/presentation/public allowlist contracts; replace copied POS catalogue with shared-authority reads only after freshness parity; adapt Next pages.
families.target_gate: Same category/filter/variant/price results, private fields never public, zero stock handled correctly, POS writes reflected through APIs and redirects retained.
families.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client

families.title: Cart orders and reviews
families.preserve: Preserve multi-line cart, quantity update/removal, order history/status/invoice access, review eligibility/moderation and admin order CSV/status operations.
families.decision: Reuse validation/ownership/review rules; migrate records and snapshots; adapt session cart and REST/Next interfaces.
families.target_gate: Guest-to-account/cart recovery, quantity/price changes, duplicate submit, ownership, signed access, eligible purchase review and moderation.
families.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client

families.title: Payments COD hosted card and wallets
families.preserve: Preserve payment manager/provider contracts, verified amount/currency/order/reference, COD collection, callback/webhook replay safety, retry/cancel and encrypted credentials.
families.decision: Reuse provider interfaces, verification and disabled-provider failures; adapt persistence/URLs; no invented gateway implementation or raw PAN/CVV collection.
families.target_gate: Amount/owner/reference tampering and replay denied; COD works; hosted gateway fakes prove contract only; authentic provider sandbox remains H-02.
families.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client

families.title: Digital services requests and project quotes
families.preserve: Preserve digital services/content, request references/status, approved quote amounts/currency, secure payment tokens and paid quote linkage.
families.decision: Reuse quote/request validation and signed access; migrate service/quote/order relationships; adapt CMS and Next public flows.
families.target_gate: Approved quote amount cannot be changed by client, ownership/token expiry and request privacy hold, status/history and paid linkage preserved.
families.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client

families.title: Website managed content navigation and SEO
families.preserve: Preserve managed page templates/content/SEO, nested menus/destinations, homepage section registry, header/footer, promotions, legal pages and protected routes.
families.decision: Reuse registries/sanitization/revision services; migrate content; adapt admin and Next rendering. Keep publication and rollback semantics.
families.target_gate: Draft isolation, protected route collisions, safe markup/URLs/media, ordering/visibility, publication/rollback and cache invalidation match.
families.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client

families.title: Website themes media settings and recovery
families.preserve: Preserve Website-specific setting keys, brand/theme tokens, safe upload/usage and replacements, secret envelopes, revisions and recovery.
families.decision: Reuse registries and recovery guards; migrate logical namespace and usage; adapt admin UI and public rendering.
families.target_gate: Secret masking/key mismatch, unsafe SVG/path rejection, usage-aware deletion/replacement, theme contrast/responsive fallbacks and revision recovery.
families.target_owner: backend services/protected CMS plus website Next.js REST client

families.title: Website integration health and jobs
families.preserve: Preserve safe integration status, outbox/reconciliation job semantics, rate/retry limits and redacted audit; distinguish local test helpers from operational commands.
families.decision: Adapt health checks to one backend; retain recovery jobs where external I/O remains; retire obsolete polling only with recorded replacement evidence.
families.target_gate: No arbitrary endpoint/command execution, disabled integration makes no call, fake retry/failure tests and scheduler/queue recovery; local mark-paid never production API.
families.target_owner: backend integration jobs, audit and operational health

families.title: Canonical brand and runtime assets
families.preserve: Preserve approved editable logo/wordmark, fonts/icons/favicon/watermark/print/runtime references and license requirements.
families.decision: Deduplicate byte-identical masters into root brand later; retain runtime derivatives only when referenced. Do not migrate old Control logo as approved artwork.
families.target_gate: Master hashes and asset manifest, view/style/build references, fallback dimensions and print contrast verified in both target applications.
families.target_owner: brand canonical masters; generated backend/website runtime derivatives

families.title: Windows Control and developer launch tooling
families.preserve: Preserve useful Start/Stop/Restart/Open/Status, LAN/QR, browser reuse and operator diagnostics; add required Start All/Stop All with current approved logo.
families.decision: Adapt useful C# UI; refactor process ownership and hard-coded paths. Port-only taskkill is unsafe; executable mirrors/launcher backup are not authoritative target source.
families.target_gate: Exact target PID/path ownership, occupied ports/stale PIDs, repeated all-actions, partial failure, no orphan/duplicate tabs, no source/unrelated process termination.
families.target_owner: tools/mobist-control single Windows application

families.title: Regression security performance and migration gates
families.preserve: Retain source regression assertions and negative security/performance/rollback contracts as migration evidence, not proof of target completion.
families.decision: Adapt fixtures/tests for shared schema and new UI incrementally; reuse assertions. Replace source-text Blade checks with behavior plus target structure checks where appropriate.
families.target_gate: Fresh target PHPUnit/Pest, MySQL concurrency, builds and Playwright; no source tests quoted as target results; all registered capabilities independently close.
families.target_owner: backend tests, website Playwright and .github monorepo CI

families.title: Framework schema and build foundation
families.preserve: Preserve Laravel configuration, middleware ordering, migration history/constraints, reproducible locks and application boot contracts.
families.decision: Reuse Laravel13 foundation, adapt shared migrations/config/CI, install dependencies fresh. React/Next presentation adapters are new; business logic rewrite is not justified.
families.target_gate: Shared schema collision/foreign key map, fresh setup and migration apply/rollback/reapply, exact toolchain locks, monorepo CI and environment isolation.
families.target_owner: backend foundation, website build contracts and .github

families.title: Historical documentation and metadata
families.preserve: Keep provenance of prior source acceptance and operational instructions without adopting old dual-database authority.
families.decision: Retain inventory/hash references; migrate only useful current runbooks. Source roadmap/old launch paths and duplicate documents are historical.
families.target_gate: Every required legacy behavior traced to target evidence; stale instructions cannot override Goal, Preferences or new registry.
families.target_owner: docs migration evidence and operational runbooks
